title: IoVnbdSchemaAllowlistConfigV1
description: WP-10.2 (Issue #80): structural shape of the six-schema IO-VNBD validation allowlist configuration consumed by tools/dataset/schema_allowlist.py. This is repository tooling configuration, not the I-20 DatasetManifest contract itself.

status.description: ACTIVE for the reviewed six-schema inventory. TEMPLATE_PENDING_S0_AUDIT_ASSIGNMENT remains available only for unresolved replacement documents; tools/dataset/schema_allowlist.py refuses to enforce any non-ACTIVE or placeholder-bearing allowlist.

allowlist.description: Exactly six schema identifiers. Per R-007 in docs/architecture/SIH26168_Risk_Register_v1.csv and C-15's six-schema allowlist in the Revision 3 architecture, IO-VNBD data uses exactly six schemas; any other schema identifier must be quarantined, never silently accepted.
